basic_details.job_title: NIT Jamshedpur Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 – Walkin

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is not exceeding 50 years as on the date of interview.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | medical officer (on contract): Essential: MBBS Degree or equivalent qualification included in any one of the Schedules of the Indian Medical Council Act 1956 (102 of 1956) and must be registered in a State Medical Register or Indian Medical Register. Desirable: Post Graduate Qualification, preferably MD in General Medicine, or equivalent qualification included in any one of the Schedules to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956) and must be registered in a State Medical Register or Indian Medical Register.

salary_details.medical officer (on contract): ₹ 1,00,000/- Per Month consolidated including all statutory entitlements.
salary_details.details: No other allowances or accommodation will be provided by the Institute.

how_to_apply: Download the application form and notification from the official website or notification link.
Fill out the prescribed application form with all required details.
Gather all original educational, professional, and identity documents along with one set of self-attested copies.
Affix a self-attested photograph on the application form.
Attend the Walk-in-Interview on 16-10-2026 from 10:30 AM at the Board Room of the Administrative Building, NIT Jamshedpur, Adityapur, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand 831014.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely temporary for an initial period of six months, which may be extended up to a maximum of one year based on performance or functional requirement. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the Walk-in-Interview. Candidates will be interviewed only after the verification of original certificates. One Casual Leave will be allowed for every completed 45 days of service, and no other benefits or leave without permission of the Competent Authority are allowed. Preference will be given to experienced doctors. Canvassing in any form or bringing outside influence will lead to immediate disqualification. Any dispute regarding the selection process is subject to the court or tribunal having jurisdiction over Seraikela Kharsawan court only.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Jamshedpur Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Download the application form and notification from the official website or notification link. Fill out the prescribed application form with all required details. Gather all original educational, professional, and identity documents along with one set of self-attested copies. Affix a self-attested photograph on the application form. Attend the Walk-in-Interview on 16-10-2026 from 10:30 AM at the Board Room of the Administrative Building, NIT Jamshedpur, Adityapur, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand 831014.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: 10th / Matriculation / SSLC Mark Sheet +2 / HSC Mark Sheet Consolidated Marksheet of Degree Degree Certificates, Registration Certificates, and Certificate of CRRI (Compulsory Rotatory Residential Internship) Experience Certificate (if any) ID Proof (Aadhar Card / Driving License / Passport / PAN Card or any Government ID with Address)
